workflows.triggers:
pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 9 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      confirm_destructive_account_deletion:
        description: Authorize deletion of a disposable staging account after staging-security review
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean
      ios_build_id:
        description: Optional exact iOS EAS build UUID or build URL tied to this evidence
        required: false
        type: string

rationale: Workflow-free evidence parent/candidate; unchanged default workflows restrict push to main or require PR/manual dispatch. No PR, dispatch, application ref or settings mutation. skip-ci supplementary only.
limitation: Repository-visible configuration; inaccessible installation internals are not independently attested.
